title: Software Developer Roadmap: Web to Systems
description: Progressive developer journey from client-side web markup (HTML/CSS/DOM) and interactive scripting (JavaScript & TypeScript) to computational problem solving, general-purpose software (Python), computer architecture, procedural systems (C), high-performance OOP (C++), and scalable backend infrastructure.

steps.note: Web platform foundation: semantic HTML5 markup, CSS layout engines (Box Model, Flexbox, Grid), and the browser DOM document tree.
Interactive client-side web scripting: DOM event handling, async promises/fetch, V8 event loop, and TypeScript static structural typing.
Computational problem solving: asymptotic complexity O(n), dynamic arrays, linked lists, hash tables, trees, and sorting.
General-purpose programming & automation: Python data model, list/dict comprehensions, OOP, modules, file I/O, and packages.
Hardware execution interface: CPU registers, ALU operations, memory hierarchy, cache lines, and instruction cycles.
Imperative systems programming: pointer arithmetic, manual heap memory management (malloc/free), structs, and ABI.
High-performance multi-paradigm systems: RAII memory safety, smart pointers, class hierarchies, templates, and STL algorithms.
Operating system foundations: processes, POSIX threads, virtual memory paging, mutex synchronization, and system calls.
Networked applications & client-server communication: TCP/IP stack, sockets, HTTP protocols, REST APIs, and distributed data systems.
Modern systems engineering: ownership, borrow checking, memory safety without garbage collection, and fearless concurrency.
Scalable concurrent backends: goroutines, typed channels, CSP concurrency, HTTP microservices, and network daemons.
